build_disagg_proxy_server: build a python module to run a FastAPI proxy that routes chat completions through encoder, prefill, and decode clusters
run_proxy_cli: run the disaggregated encoder proxy CLI with encode, prefill, and decode server URLs
test_chat_completions: test the /v1/chat/completions endpoint that routes multimodal requests through encoder and decode clusters
test_health_check: test the /health endpoint that checks the health of encoder, prefill, and decode clusters
run_profiling_commands: run /start_profile and /stop_profile endpoints that fan-out profiling commands to all clusters
